violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -Shell eggs in a single cardboard holder were found in the cold-hold prep table stored on the top rack above bagged ham and other meats.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -A container of biscuits dated 7/16/26 were found in the cooler.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -The refrigerated prep table for the kitchen has a broken door. The left-hand door is tapped on and the hinge is broken.
